comment:
* BpfMap is a key -> value mapping structure that is designed to maintained the bpf map entries.
 * This is a wrapper class of in-kernel data structure. The in-kernel data can be read/written by
 * passing syscalls with map file descriptor.
 *
 * @param <K> the key of the map.
 * @param <V> the value of the map.

methods.name: private static ParcelFileDescriptor cachedBpfFdGet(String path, int mode, int keySize, int valueSize) throws ErrnoException, NullPointerException
public void updateEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Update an existing or create a new key -> value entry in an eBbpf map.
     * (use insertOrReplaceEntry() if you need to know whether insert or replace happened)

methods.name: public void insertEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException, IllegalStateException
methods.comment:
* If the key does not exist in the map, insert key -> value entry into eBpf map.
     * Otherwise IllegalStateException will be thrown.

methods.name: public void replaceEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException, NoSuchElementException
methods.comment:
* If the key already exists in the map, replace its value. Otherwise NoSuchElementException
     * will be thrown.

methods.name: public boolean insertOrReplaceEntry(K key, V value) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Update an existing or create a new key -> value entry in an eBbpf map.
     * Returns true if inserted, false if replaced.
     * (use updateEntry() if you don't care whether insert or replace happened)
     * Note: see inline comment below if running concurrently with delete operations.

methods.name: public boolean deleteEntry(K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Remove existing key from eBpf map. Return false if map was not modified.

methods.name: private K getNextKeyInternal(@Nullable K key) throws ErrnoException
public K getNextKey(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment:
* Get the next key of the passed-in key. If the passed-in key is not found, return the first
     * key. If the passed-in key is the last one, return null.
     *
     * TODO: consider allowing null passed-in key.

methods.name: public K getFirstKey() throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Get the first key of eBpf map.

methods.name: public boolean containsKey(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Check whether a key exists in the map.

methods.name: public V getValue(@NonNull K key) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: Retrieve a value from the map. Return null if there is no such key.
